'''''Executrix''''' was the first [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator''-class Star Destroyer]], launched late during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
As the first of its make, the ''Executrix'' was one of a handful of ''Imperator''-class ships scheduled to do live-fire exercises during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] before full production of the class was to begin.<ref name="TOEG:S1" />

Commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Darcc]], ''Executrix'' later led an [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|assault]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] approximately two months after the conclusion of the Wars.<ref name="DL" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In chapter 37 of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', the ''Executrix'' is erroneously referred to as the ''Executor''.<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>
